summary: Finished the harness for the stale-configuration safety question and queued it for execution on the fixed snapshot. It builds a five-voter commit-tracking cluster, removes two voters, snapshots the node under test while the smaller configuration is in force, re-adds them, commits later traffic, restarts that node (live configuration = the snapshot's three-voter set, recommitted entry still in its log), transfers leadership to it, and observes whether the write it acknowledges is held by a true majority and whether a leader elected from the configuration in force still has it. Added source ranges for the commitment quorum rule and quorumSize, plus a conditional source-derived account with the pending receipt as discriminator; local construction feedback showed the full chain, but it is not retained evidence, so the defect claim stays unresolved until the receipt is read.
